directions.name: Ignition
directions.description: Kinetic and aggressive. Canvas particle/ember field drifts behind the hero headline, which stagger-enters with slight overshoot. Sharp, angular chevron-cut cards and buttons lifted from OSP's reference screenshot. Radial glow lighting instead of shadows — everything looks lit from within. Asymmetric, alternating section rhythm with slide-in-from-left/right reveals using elastic overshoot easing. Chevron trails pulse along section dividers scrubbed to scroll position. Magnetic CTA buttons pull toward the cursor. Stat counters count up with a glowing pulse on scroll-into-view. Infinite CSS marquee for the logo carousel, pausing on hover.
directions.rationale: OSP sells measurable growth. This direction makes speed and results the visual language itself — chevrons as forward momentum, glowing numbers as proof, motion that never sits still.

directions.name: Signal
directions.description: Premium and controlled. Opens on a loading screen where the OSP gradient magnifying-glass mark draws/fades in, performs a light-beam scan sweep, then clip-path wipes into the hero (session-gated, plays once). Split-screen hero instead of full-bleed. Glassmorphic dark cards — frosted, blurred, orange-tinted — with 3D mouse-tilt on hover. Consistent grid, generous whitespace, dramatic soft shadows and layered depth. Cursor-reactive radial glow follows the pointer. Lenis-powered inertia smooth scroll site-wide. Staggered fade+slide entrances with soft easing, no overshoot. Portfolio/case-study grid crossfades to stats on hover. Astro View Transitions wipe between routes.
directions.rationale: This reads as the premium, authoritative side of OSP — confident enough to slow down and let the work speak. The scanning-logo intro turns the brand name itself into the site's signature moment.
